Loyal.name: Loyal
Loyal.description:
🫂 You stand by your people. When a friend or partner is in trouble, you are already moving.

🤝 You cover a partner's blind side, and partners fight better beside you.
⚠️ You follow friends into bad decisions, even when the friend is wrong.
⚠️ Enemies can reach you through the people you care about, and betrayal takes a long time to forgive.

📈 Grants: Team Coordination +5
Loyal.traitNarrativeEffects: The character keeps faith with friends, partners and teams: they cover a partner's blind side, keep secrets, answer when called and defend their people in public. Partners fight better beside them. Weakness: they follow friends into bad decisions and struggle to see their friends' faults. A friend's request can override their own judgment, and enemies can reach them through the people they care about. Betrayal hits hard and takes a long time to forgive. The narrator shows a friend's pull on them; where their loyalty ends, and whether they forgive, is the player's decision.
